subject: Final go/no-go: MAP acceptance, counter-sign timing, and Day 1 start plan
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@beaconhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T15:12:00Z
Subject: Draft MAP and procurement timeline

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for walking us through the eval last week. Attached is our consolidated MAP (Beacon_MAP_v3.xlsx) with internal dates and a first-pass procurement note from Sarah in procurement. High level: we plan a pilot scope that matches the SOW you shared, target start date June 7, and a one-week canary prior to full roll.

Two asks from our side so we can lock the schedule:
- Can you confirm the final signer windows (your side) and whether we can do an e-sign flow?
- Any known SLA exceptions we should route to legal now (dedicated capacity start lag, data residency timeline)?

If we can land sign-off by 2027-05-12 (PO + signatures) we can meet June 7. Please loop in legal and CS for any callouts.

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Head of Integrations, BeaconHealth

Attachment: Beacon_MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet, 56KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@beaconhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T09:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Draft MAP and procurement timeline

Elaine —

Appreciate the clear MAP. I've attached the SOW (SOW-Beacon-V1.pdf) and a short summary doc with our recommended signer windows. Proposed plan from Redwood:

1) Internal approval cadence (Redwood): legal sign-off by 2027-05-06, finance clearance 2027-05-09.
2) Two signing windows for Beacon to choose: 2027-05-11 (preferred) or 2027-05-18 (backup). Both are compatible with a June 7 Day 1 if PO arrives within 2 business days after signature.
3) We'll enable DocuSign for execution; Kimberly has the redline lane.
4) For the dedicated capacity ramp: we'll reserve the first week as a canary and limit throughput to the pilot SLA until Day 8. If you need an accelerated ramp, we can request an SLA exception (requires executive approval).

Camila from CS — can you confirm onboarding bandwidth the week of June 7 and whether we should schedule a Day 0 dry-run?

Next steps: Kimberly, quick legal pass and DocuSign setup; Elaine, confirm which signing window Beacon prefers and procurement PO timing.

Thanks,
Karthik
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW-Beacon-V1.pdf (PDF, 132KB); MAP-summary.xlsx (spreadsheet, 18KB)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Elaine Park <elaine@beaconhealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-23T14:37:00Z
Subject: Re: Draft MAP and procurement timeline

Hi all —

I've reviewed the Beacon redlines and put a short legal-only redline doc into the thread (Redlines_Legal_2027-04-22.docx). Key callouts:
- Minor SLA language edits (clarifying pilot throughput and canary limits).
- Data retention appendix: Beacon asked for a 30-day audit log export cadence; acceptable but would prefer 90 days by default — I added both options as alternatives.
- Exec-level SLA exception: if Beacon needs an accelerated dedicated capacity ramp (full pilot throughput Day 1), that requires a sign-off from our Head of Dedicated Services. That approval path is 48–72 hours once requested; we should decide now whether it's needed.

I've created a DocuSign envelope (link below) with the current redline view. If Beacon is OK with the redlines, I can produce the final version and send for signatures in the 05-11 window. If you prefer 05-18, we can pivot.

DocuSign (preview): https://app.docusign.com/BEACON-REDLINES-2027

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Elaine Park <elaine@beaconhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: BeaconHealth Procurement <procurement@beaconhealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-27T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Draft MAP and procurement timeline

Thanks — this is helpful. Procurement confirms PO target 2027-05-12 (procurement will issue immediately after signatures). Beacon prefers the 2027-05-11 signing window (signers available that week).

On the SLA exception: we do not need an accelerated full-throughput ramp on Day 1; the one-week canary is fine. Regarding audit logs, Beacon accepts the 90-day default with a 30-day optional cadence for exports — Kimberly's language looks good.

Action items and final go/no-go flow:
- Redwood: final contract with Kimberly's redlines to DocuSign by EOD 2027-05-03.
- Beacon: signatures on 2027-05-11 (DocuSign) + procurement PO by 2027-05-12.
- CS (Camila): schedule Day 0 dry-run for 2027-06-04 and onboarding kickoff for 2027-06-07.

If those items land on the dates above, Beacon confirms "go" for June 7 start. Please confirm and I'll share the signer list to procurement.

Best,
Elaine
